name: @temples/jquery
description: jQuery plugin for the temples template engine: $.fn.temples(data).

scripts.build: bun build src/jquery.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json --external @temples/engine --entry-naming "[name].[ext]" && bun build src/jquery.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json --external @temples/engine --minify --entry-naming "[name].min.[ext]" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
